answer_1.quote: GOLDCOIN combines the formalization of contextual integrity with concrete seed norms in privacy laws to generate the synthetic background stories

answer_2.quote: we calculate the ROUGE-L similarity for each case background against others

answer_4.quote: To further investigate the quality, we enlist two experts to evaluate the synthetic cases using the criteria outlined in Table 1.
answer_4.guideline: Table 1: Human analysis of synthetic case quality, including questions: 'Does HIPAA apply to this case?', 'Is the case strongly related to the seed norm?', 'Is the compliance of the case correct?', 'All fields are valid'
